themes.label: Pricing/Cost
themes.describe: Users feel the cost is too high relative to the features provided.

themes.label: Feature Limitations
themes.describe: Essential features are locked behind higher, more expensive subscription tiers.

themes.label: Login/Account Bugs
themes.describe: Users encounter technical errors when trying to log in or create accounts via the app.

themes.label: Core Functionality Failure
themes.describe: The app is reported as not working or failing to perform its intended tasks.

themes.label: Support Responsiveness
themes.describe: Users are frustrated by slow or non-existent responses from customer support.

themes.label: Support Channel Needs
themes.describe: There is a request for more immediate support options, like live chat.

themes.label: Stability/Reliability
themes.describe: General complaints about the app not working consistently or being unreliable.

themes.label: Positive Feedback
themes.describe: Reviews that express satisfaction with the app's current performance.
